KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

2. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

3. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.

4. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.

5. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.

6. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.

7. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. pana
   C. nene
   D. fupi

8. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mato
   B. kitoto
   C. mitoto
   D. watoto

9. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.

10. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Dukani and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
